blocks.text:
The music card and the island’s sound bars take on the album art’s color.

Inspired by ColorFlow by David Goldman. Re-created from scratch for Folio; no tweak code is included.

items: The music card follows the album art
The island’s sound bars match it

entries.notes: Colored Albums becomes a package in the Folio Market. The tweak itself has shipped with Folio since 0.6.0.
